data.desc: As a leading strategic partner to government, Maximus improves the delivery of public services amid complex technology, health, economic, and social challenges. Maximus provides tech-enabled services to government agencies, including innovative business process management and technology solutions, which improve outcomes for the public and create higher levels of productivity and efficiency of government-sponsored programs. With a deep understanding of program service delivery, acute insights that achieve operational excellence, and an extensive awareness of the needs of the people being served, our employees advance the critical missions of our partners.
